why.en: Shows the SSID, band, channel and security type your laptop negotiated with the access point.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki tumhare laptop ne access point ke saath kaunsa SSID, band, channel aur security type negotiate kiya.

expect.en: You will see fields like SSID, Radio type, Channel and Authentication (for example WPA2-Personal) with Cipher CCMP. Values depend on your network.
expect.hinglish: SSID, Radio type, Channel aur Authentication (jaise WPA2-Personal) aur Cipher CCMP jaise fields dikhenge. Values tumhare network par depend karti hain.

title.en: List nearby networks and their beacons
title.hinglish: Aas-paas ke networks aur unke beacons list karo

why.en: Lists the networks whose beacons your laptop hears, with their security.
why.hinglish: Un networks ko list karta hai jinke beacons tumhara laptop sunta hai, unki security ke saath.

expect.en: A list of SSIDs with signal strength, channel and authentication such as WPA2 or WPA3. Output varies by place.
expect.hinglish: SSIDs ki list signal strength, channel aur WPA2 ya WPA3 jaisi authentication ke saath. Output jagah ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

title.en: Find the 4-way handshake in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and filter for EAPOL key messages.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur EAPOL key messages filter karo.

expect.en: Four EAPOL-Key frames: message 1 with the ANonce, message 2 with SNonce and MIC, message 3 with the GTK, message 4 as the final ack.
expect.hinglish: Chaar EAPOL-Key frames: message 1 mein ANonce, message 2 mein SNonce aur MIC, message 3 mein GTK, message 4 aakhri ack.

why.en: Management frame subtype 8 is a Beacon and subtype 12 is a Deauthentication.
why.hinglish: Management frame subtype 8 Beacon hai aur subtype 12 Deauthentication.

expect.en: Beacons showing SSID HomeNet and the RSN element, plus the deauth frames (reason 15 or 7) in the other scenarios.
expect.hinglish: SSID HomeNet aur RSN element dikhate beacons, aur dusre scenarios mein deauth frames (reason 15 ya 7).
